The Open Data Lab is built through the work of student researchers and contributors who develop original analyses using public data and reproducible workflows.

Each contributor represents part of a growing, public-facing body of civic data research—transforming coursework into published, portfolio-ready work.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## A Community of Contributors

Contributors to the Lab:

- explore real-world questions about New York City\
- analyze publicly available datasets\
- develop reproducible research using R and Quarto\
- publish their work as part of the Lab’s ecosystem

This model creates a collaborative environment where individual work contributes to a larger, evolving platform.

## Join the Lab

The Open Data Lab provides opportunities for students to contribute to real-world projects in civic data, open-source software, reproducible research, and applied analytics.

Students can get involved through structured internships and ongoing Lab initiatives, with opportunities designed around meaningful project ownership, skill development, and public-facing work.

::: {.callout-tip .join-callout}
### Interested in getting involved or have an idea for how you could contribute?

[**Get in touch**](mailto:c.martinez0@outlook.com) to discuss potential opportunities.
:::

### Summer Internship Program

The Open Data Lab Summer Internship Program provides students with the opportunity to contribute to long-term projects that extend beyond the classroom. Interns work closely with the Lab to develop open-source software, reproducible research, and analytical tools while gaining experience with collaborative software development, technical communication, and public scholarship.

Each internship track is designed around ownership of a meaningful project, giving interns the opportunity to create work that can contribute to GitHub portfolios, conference presentations, publications, and future research collaborations.

::: {#internships}
:::

### CUNY Sports Analytics Initiative

The Open Data Lab is building a student-driven sports analytics team that uses real collegiate athletics data to support CUNY coaches, players, and teams.

Students can contribute through sports analytics or data development, working on scouting reports, performance analysis, data visualization, database development, and reproducible analytical workflows.

[Apply to the CUNY Sports Analytics Team](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdRmNDdMDB9ZJb2ZIJGHAzfwBdY25dl-Co0h42UarCo8MJx8g/viewform?usp=header){.btn .btn-primary}

[Learn more about the CUNY Sports Analytics Initiative](projects.qmd#sec-cuny-sports-analytics)
